summary: This resolution sets House floor procedures for considering H.R. 4593 (revising the showerhead definition), H.R. 5184 (blocking DOE enforcement of manufactured housing efficiency standards, with a committee substitute adopted), and H.R. 6938 (FY2026 consolidated appropriations), waiving points of order, limiting each to one hour of debate, and requiring separate votes on retaining divisions of the appropriations bill.

This creates a tangential but clear procedural link to government spending.
